config.description: Constrained GridWorld: noisy/delayed observation, partial map, dynamic obstacles.
config.interpretation_caveat: L2 goal_complexity / Φ-IQ under default discrete GridWorld largely reflects BFS/Manhattan planner competence, not G′-scored control (D-156/D-161). Use --enable-blended-scorer for prediction-scored path.

gate.rule: PHCA must beat each gated control on >=75% of scenario metrics
gate.note: greedy_full_info is reported as a ceiling unless explicitly gated

secondary_prediction.note: PHCA-only model-fit dual-report (D-195 / L4 dual PE pattern). Scenario PASS under geometry-dominated selection ≠ prediction competence; PE does not affect gate.passed.

gate.interpretation_note: PASS/FAIL under geometry-dominated action selection measures planner competence vs baselines, not prediction-primary control (D-156/D-161). RBTA violation rate is reported but not gated. See secondary_prediction for PE dual-report (not gated).
